**[Ackermann Steering Model]{.underline}**

**Variables:**

- **L,** Wheelbase (The distance between the front and rear axle centers) \[meter\]

- **R,** Turning radius to the midpoint of the rear axle \[Meter\]

- $\delta$ **-** Steering angle of both wheels equally, only assuming inner wheel since both wheels will turn the same amount (there is no need for a differential).

$\tan\delta\  = \ L/R\  = \ L\lbrack m\rbrack/6\lbrack m\rbrack$

$\delta = tan^{- 1}\left( \frac{L}{R} \right)*\frac{180}{\pi}$
